description: Creative-repair demo scenarios from demo-candidate-factory 20260723-001. Curated for quality: nefarious topology-level defects on complex workflows, excluding trivial upscale widget tweaks.

scenarios.title: Every queue gives me the exact same image
scenarios.query: No matter how many times I queue the workflow, I get the exact same image. I'm not trying to lock the seed, but there's no variation between runs at all.
scenarios.description: A Flux2 workflow's noise seed was locked to 'fixed', so every run reproduced the identical image. The fixer sets the noise control to randomize so each queue rolls a fresh seed.

scenarios.title: Every image comes out horizontally squished
scenarios.query: All my images come out squished horizontally — people look short and wide and objects are distorted — even though my prompt doesn't ask for anything unusual. It's like the aspect ratio is collapsed.
scenarios.description: An SD3 text-to-image workflow created its latent canvas with width and height swapped, so the model sampled a distorted frame. The fixer sets the width to match the height.

scenarios.title: The generated audio is completely silent
scenarios.query: The workflow runs without errors and produces an audio file, but it's completely silent — no speech at all, just a blank file.
scenarios.description: A Qwen3 voice-clone workflow had an empty target-text field, so the synthesizer had nothing to speak and emitted silence. The fixer fills in the text to be spoken.

scenarios.title: The image looks like it's avoiding my prompt
scenarios.query: Something's off with the generation — the result comes out like the opposite of what I described, as if the negative prompt is driving the image instead of the positive one.
scenarios.description: Positive and negative conditioning were wired to the wrong sampler inputs, so the model was guided away from the intended prompt. The fixer swaps the two conditioning feeds back.

scenarios.title: The cloned voice reads my English text with a heavy accent
scenarios.query: The audio file is generated fine, but the voice pronounces my English text with a heavy, unnatural accent — like it's reading English through Chinese phonetics.
scenarios.description: A Qwen3 voice-design workflow had its language widget set to Chinese, so English text was mis-pronounced. The fixer sets the language to English.

scenarios.title: Add a refinement pass to smooth my LTX video
scenarios.query: My two-stage LTX video workflow only runs the coarse pass right now, so the output looks rough. Can you add the second refinement pass to clean it up?
scenarios.description: Additive: an LTXV workflow missing its second-stage refinement. The fixer adds a ManualSigmas schedule and wires it into the second sampler for a smoothing pass.

scenarios.title: Add an upscale step so my output isn't low resolution
scenarios.query: My final image comes out lower resolution than I'd like — there's no upscale step in the workflow. Can you add a 2× upscale before saving so the output keeps its detail?
scenarios.description: Additive: an image workflow with no upscale stage. The fixer adds a 2× ImageScale (Lanczos) between the source and the save node so the output doubles in resolution.

scenarios.title: Add text-to-song generation to this audio workflow
scenarios.query: I've got the ACE-Step models loaded here, but nothing actually generates audio right now — there's no generation path wired up. Can you add text-to-song generation so a prompt produces a finished, saveable track?
scenarios.description: Additive: a workflow with the ACE-Step models loaded but no generation path connected to the audio output. The fixer adds the text-to-song chain (text encode, audio latent, sampler, VAE decode) and wires the audio output.

scenarios.title: Add a fast 4-step Lightning path to this Qwen workflow
scenarios.query: This Qwen image workflow works but it's slow — it runs the full base sampler. Can you add the accelerated four-step Lightning path so it generates much faster, without changing my prompt or output size?
scenarios.description: Additive: a Qwen workflow running the slow base sampler. The fixer adds the Lightning LoRA plus a four-step ModelSampling configuration and rewires the model feed, leaving prompt and output size unchanged.

scenarios.title: Add a quick low-quality preview render for fast iteration
scenarios.query: My main render looks great but it's too slow for prompt iteration. Can you add a fast, low-quality preview render alongside it — same prompt and canvas — so I can tweak quickly before committing to the full render?
scenarios.description: Additive: a Flux2 workflow with only the full-quality render. The fixer adds a second, fast distilled-preview sampler branch that shares the prompt and canvas and writes its own preview output.

scenarios.title: Generate four upscaled versions so I can compare them
scenarios.query: I want to compare a few different upscalers on the same image. Can you set it up so the workflow produces four upscaled versions — each with a different model — and saves them separately, so I can pick the one that preserves the source best?
scenarios.description: Additive: an image workflow with a single upscale. The fixer adds three more upscale branches (distinct models: UltraSharp, RealESRGAN, etc.), each saved separately for side-by-side comparison.

scenarios.title: My exported video plays in slow motion and the audio drifts
scenarios.query: The video I save plays back in slow motion, and the audio slowly drifts out of sync with it. The generated frames themselves look fine — it's only the saved file that plays wrong.
scenarios.description: A Wan2.2 sound-to-video workflow exported at 4 fps instead of 24, so the container's timebase made playback crawl and desync from the audio. The fixer sets the VideoCombine frame rate to match the sampler output.

scenarios.title: Add face-performance guidance from a reference video
scenarios.query: My speech-to-video clip reacts to the audio and portrait, but the character's motion is generic — it doesn't follow the performance in my guide video. Can you add pose guidance from the guide video so the character moves with it?
scenarios.description: Additive: a Wan sound-to-video workflow with no pose-guidance input wired in. The fixer adds a WanVideoEncode for the guide video and feeds it into the open pose-latent input.
